name: .308 Cal-174gr Hammer Hunter®
note: Recommended use: Big Game Hunting. The product page also says: "This bullet is designed to fit factory length magazines of the long actions at 3.34″ and the short actions at 2.8″ oal cartridge lengths. The product name says 174 gr; the specification says 172 gr.
